package probe

import "os/exec"

// The accepted counterparts of env_receiver.go.txt: a receiver the check does
// not follow takes a proven Env value as any other receiver does, an Env key
// of another struct's literal too, and the e2e tier's own forms are the ones
// it writes (an empty literal, an append of one).

type envAcceptedHolder struct {
	cmd *exec.Cmd
}

func envFieldAccepted(s *envAcceptedHolder) {
	s.cmd.Env = []string{}
}

func envDerefAccepted(cmd *exec.Cmd) {
	(*cmd).Env = []string{"PATH=/usr/bin"}
}

func envAppendAccepted(cmd *exec.Cmd, env []string) {
	cmd.Env = append([]string{}, env...)
}

func envValueCopyAccepted(cmd *exec.Cmd) {
	v := *cmd
	v.Env = []string{}
}

type envAcceptedSettings struct {
	Env []string
}

func envKeyAccepted() {
	_ = envAcceptedSettings{Env: []string{}}
}

// A type assertion hands back a command the check never built, and a proven
// Env assigned through it is accepted as through any other receiver: the
// assertion's type is one of the places a *exec.Cmd may be declared (P2).
func envAssertAccepted(v any) {
	cmd := v.(*exec.Cmd)
	cmd.Env = []string{}
}
